output.description: Sets the archive directory's permissions to owner-full, group read/execute, no access for others, then moves a local repository checkout into it. It permanently deletes build artifacts and caches (node_modules, __pycache__, build, dist, .venv, .pytest_cache) from the archived copy.
output.declaring_phrase: Sets the archive directory's permissions to owner-full, group read/execute, no access for others
